new_fits.fit_semantics: one residual-memory construction per origin and arm; no estimator or text-geometry refit

recipe.geometry: reuse frozen target-free A02 word-TFIDF top32 geometry; positive cosine neighbors only; stable order cosine descending then source row ascending

recipe.donor_residual: threat_rank minus frozen R06 OOF prediction whose source cutoff is strictly before donor cycle
recipe.residual_summary: weighted median; stable residual then donor source row order; midpoint between distinct values when cumulative weight is exactly half

recipe.query_baseline: origin-specific full R06 prediction cache for every query row; never donor OOF per-cycle mapping
recipe.shuffle: within exact donor cycle by fixed R06 prediction decile min(9,floor(clip(prediction,0,100)/10)); NumPy default_rng(42) reset for each origin; cells ascending cycle then decile and rows ascending official source row
